glosses: moral (conforming to a standard of right behaviour)

examples.text: Tenemos una responsabilidad moral de actuar.
examples.en: We have a moral responsibility to act.
We will give them moral support.

examples.text: Ella está ahora con la moral baja.
examples.en: She is now in a low frame of mind.

examples.text: La moral de aquellos hombres era magnífica.
examples.en: The morale of those men was excellent.
